plan.stretchHint: Clip stretch (max_stretch / fill_method from settings) scales Director-suggested source motion into exact timeline slots — higher stretch = longer atmospheric holds or slower peaks for the visual arc.

plan.diagAlert: Director LLM did not produce distinct per-cut visual prompts (hover the chip for the raw model output head + reason, e.g. ``` or echoed style). Automatic energy cue variations were injected instead of pure repeats. Edit the boxes above or use the <bold>Regenerate</bold> form below with more specific guidance. For very long songs (75+ cuts) the small local model often struggles — shorter guidance or a stronger pulled gemma helps.

plan.regenAllHint: Regenerate all prompts with the Director (uses current song cut plan + your guidance)
plan.guidancePlaceholder: Optional guidance (e.g. 'abstract mood arc, slow light play and textures in the intro, sharp pulsing geometry at the drop, ethereal and dissolving in the outro')
plan.tip: Tip: Guidance shapes the VISUAL TREATMENT first (the creative story arc in your exact style), then the per-cut prompts are derived from it. Example: “a lone vampire gunslinger seeks revenge; the town awakens with undead in the drop; tragic quiet beauty in the outro”. The Director uses a dedicated small/fast model (gemma4:e4b by default, overridable via director_model in settings) — separate from your main chat/brain model — for reliable structured JSON output. Manual "Regen this storyboard" now adds a random variation to the seed so the same prompt usually produces a visibly different image.
plan.locked: Plan is locked (generation started or complete). The prompts above are what the Director produced and what was used for the stills + motion.

create.title: New music video
create.enableVideoEditor: Enable Video Editor in Plugins to assemble the final cut. Analysis and clip generation can still run.
create.name: Name
create.projectHelp: File it under a Guaardvark project: the finished video shows in that project's Videos and Documents.
create.stylePlaceholder: animation style, deep blue colors, loss and heartache, slow movement
create.treatment: Visual Treatment / Short Story (optional — paste or write the full narrative the Director should follow)
create.treatmentPlaceholder: Paste a detailed story or treatment here (e.g. the 1000-word gothic western vignette). The Director will use this as the screenplay and map it to the song's energy arc and cuts. Leave blank to let the AI invent one from the style prompt.
create.fillHelp: How a clip is stretched to fill its cut. Forward = no reverse (fixes the moonwalk).
create.stretchHelp: Higher = fewer clips, more slow-mo. 2 = natural. Raise to trade GPU for slowdown.
create.interpHelp: More frames for smoother slow-mo. Cheap (no extra diffusion).
create.stepsHelp: Bump a hair for crisper frames when slowing clips down more.
create.planningModeHelp: Narrative = consistent world + characters. Visual = abstract mood arc / energy-driven visuals (great for instrumental, ambient, soundtrack).
create.planningVisual: Visual / mood arc (abstract, textures, energy poem)
create.useDirector: Use Director for distinct per-cut prompts (recommended)
create.useLora: Use LoRA consistency (bake cast identity into keyframes — Z-Image/SDXL/FLUX by train base; i2v does not reload face LoRAs)
create.loraHint: Checked = lock a trained character into every cut (LoRA + identity core). Pick cast below; keyframes are generated on demand from each cut prompt. Unchecked = free stills without identity lock.
create.castLoadFailed: Cast Library could not be loaded: {{reason}}. <retry>Retry</retry>
create.noCast: No trained characters found. Train one in the Cast Library first.
create.castHelp: Their trigger word + appearance bible are injected into every keyframe.
create.i2vModelHelp: Default follows the active video model. Pick any installed I2V family your card can hold.
create.keyframeAuto: Keyframe still model is automatic from the cast character's training base (Z-Image / SDXL / FLUX). Storyboard frames are generated on demand from each cut prompt + LoRA.
create.keyframeModelHelp: Z-Image Turbo renders the stills offline with the Images page's model; FLUX-schnell and SDXL render through ComfyUI.
create.queueHint: A generation is in progress — additional creations will queue (GPU work serializes automatically).
